properties.name: Kraken AD&D 2E Syrinscape
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: Syrinscape sounds for AD&D 2E from the game's chat: weapon swings and hits, damage types, critical hits, automatic misses and Krits & Fumbles results, spells by name, school or caster level, saves, mirror image and stoneskin, turn undead, wounds, healing and initiative. Nine sound categories and every setting in Options > Kraken Syrinscape. GM side only; /krakensyrin help.
